Ecosia’s own blog posts describe investments in solar power and a general commitment to renewable energy, but they do not explicitly state that the servers running Ecosia AI are powered by renewable sources. A third‑party SINK Project report describes Ecosia’s operational footprint as “200% renewable energy ownership,” and an independent comparison article notes Ecosia’s claim that its AI generates more solar and wind power than it consumes, suggesting a renewable bias. However, no source identifies the specific hosting providers used for Ecosia AI or confirms that those providers pledge renewable or carbon‑neutral operations. The available evidence therefore supports the notion that Ecosia aims for renewable energy use, but stops short of conclusively proving that the AI service is hosted on renewable energy.
